cc:Work.dc:title: Rank Blocks by Size
cc:Work.dc:description: Rank Blocks by Size. Actual evaluation checkpoints. Pale shapes show central 95% empirical bootstrap distributions of binary rollout means, not training-seed variation. Yellow stars mark each method's first checkpoint with 100% success.
